svg.title: R-antimatter-P - Antimatter Containment - plan
svg.text: Antimatter Containment holds the ship's reserve of antihydrogen in magnetic bottles and feeds it, a few
milligrams at a time, to the matter / antimatter injector that powers the warp core; it is the most dangerous
room aboard and is staffed by a two-person containment watch.
Capacitor banks (south wall, east of the injector)
Operator console and seat (east wall, north of the door)
Radiation and decontamination station (east wall, south of the door)
Ceiling sensors, sprinklers and alert bars
Hazard warnings, beacons and fire safety
Floor props as oriented footprints (front edge heavy); wall items = bars on wall; ceiling items dotted
DECK 4 - HOLD DECK - FLOOR PLAN AT FFL -4.000
